snippet.title: Seferia Matrix
snippet.description:
Lock & Roll to make your hand and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

Seferia Matrix is a Roguelike desckbuilder with dice.
Build your mage out of 2 classes and 3 schools to compete in ranking.
The only limit is your imagination, and you can make your own luck!

Play now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4515500/Seferia_Matrix/
